name: Tsukuyomi Shiori
source:
A former lady's maid. She was the daughter of a good family, but her family was ruined and she is now in ruins (was ruined by the Tenkuin family?). The AI Demeter predicted that she would give birth to an excellent heir, and so she was chosen as one of the pregnant maids. She was promised that if she could successfully give birth to an heir, the revival of her family's fortunes would be ensured, and although she is reluctant, she has accepted her fate for the sake of her family. She has a high level of pride, but is easily hurt.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/harameido/]official site[/url]]
